units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 2:7:2">Y. Bets. II, 61ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>סדיני</he>‌<he>ן … היו קוֹפְלִין אותן</he> they spread sheets on the floor, and, when the guests left, they folded them up.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 6:4">Men. VI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 75b">75ᵇ</cite>), v. <cite ref="K01026"><he>כָּפַל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">Gen. R. s. 52</cite> <he>היה קוֹפֵל את הוילון וכ׳</he> he had the curtain rolled up and spoke to him; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">ib.</cite> s. 74 <he>מְקַפֵּל</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> <he>שלשה … קְפָלוּהוּ</he> for three months they kept the Tabernacle rolled up (did not put it up); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 417:1">Yalk. ib. 417</cite>; (Tanḥ. P’ḳudé 11 <he>היה מונה ומפורק</he>).

Ḥull. 91ᵇ קְפָלָהּ הקב״ה לכל וכ׳ (Ms. H. קִיפֵּל) the Lord rolled up the entire land of Israel and placed it under him (Jacob); Gen. R. s. 69 קפלה כפינקס he folded it together like a book of writing tablets; a. fr.—Trnsf. to overlap, combine. Tanḥ. Lekh 11 תשע … הקב״ה וכ׳ the Lord combined 980 generations in order to give the law of circumcision to Abraham (alluding to Ps. CV, 8); ib. תתקע״ד דור וכ׳ the Lord combined 974 generations in order to give the Law to the generation of the wilderness; Cant. R. to IV, 4 (ref. to אלף המגן, ib.) אלף דור קָפַלְתִּי וכ׳ I combined a thousand generations and brought that shield (the Law) which was the desire of your heart.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 121b:6">B. Bath. 121ᵇ</cite> <he>שבעה קָפְלוּ וכ׳</he> (Rashb. <he>קִיפְּלוּ</he>) seven persons overlapped an entire world (lived through many generations): Methusalem saw Adam, Shem saw Methuselah &c.—Part. pass. <cite ref="S01715"><he>קָפוּל</he></cite>; pl. <he>קְפוּלִים</he>. Ohol. XI, 3 <he>ק׳ זו ע״ג זו</he> folded up (packed) one above the other.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">Gen. R. s. 52</cite> <he>לנביאי או״ה אינו מְקַפֵּל אותו וכ׳</he> for the gentile prophets the Lord does not lift the curtain, but speaks to them from behind it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:3">Sabb. II, 3</cite> <he>פתילת … שקִיפְּלָהּ וכ׳</he> a wick made of rags which one has twisted but not yet singed.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 15:3">Ib. XV, 3</cite> <he>מְקַפְּלִין את הכלים  וכ׳</he> you may fold garments &c.

<cite ref="Sotah 36a:6">Sot. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>וקִיפְּלוּ את האבנים</he> and they doubled up (packed) the stones, v. infra; (Tosef. ib. VIII, 8 <he>ונטלו</he>); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְקוּפָּל</he>; f. <he>מְקוּפֶּלֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְקוּפָּלִים</he>, <he>מְקוּפָּלִין</he>; <he>מְקוּפָּלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 58a">Sabb. 58ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 147a:4">147ᵃ</cite> <he>היוצא בטלית מק׳ וכ׳</he> he that goes out with a cloak rolled up and laid over his shoulder.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>סוחרי כסות … מק׳ וכ׳</he> dealers in clothes who go out with cloaks rolled up and laid &c.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 84">Sifré Num. 84</cite> <he>וכשהם חונין … מק׳ ועומד</he> and when they encamped, the pillar of cloud remained rolled up.
<cite ref="Taanit 31a:6">Taan. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ מק׳ וכ׳</he> even when folded and lying in the chest; a. e.—

senses.gloss: to double up, lay up in layers, pack.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 8:4">Ned. VIII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Nedarim 61b:6">61ᵇ</cite>) <he>עד שיַקְפִּילוּ המקצועות</he> Bab. ed. (Y. ed. <he>שיכפילו</he>; Mish. <he>שיְקַפְּלוּ</he>), v. <cite ref="M02441"><he>מַקְצוּעָה</he></cite>; (ib. 61ᵇ Gemarah <he>שיכפלו</he>, <he>שיכפילו</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:3">Tosef. Dem. I, 3</cite> <he>משיקפלו</he>; Y. ib. I, beg. 21ᶜ <he>משיקפלו</he>.

senses.gloss: to be laid up in layers, be folded up.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 62a:1">Ned. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>הוּקְפְּלוּ רוב וכ׳</he> if most of the figs have been packed (most of the knives have been folded up).
